sql_templates.description: Fetch latest signals and their outcomes for sector-relative review.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_signals AS (
                SELECT 
                    s.symbol, 
                    s.sector, 
                    s.hit_target, 
                    s.hit_stop, 
                    s.return_pct, 
                    s.date_issued,
                    st.stage
                FROM 
                    signals.signal_log s
                JOIN 
                    scores.stage_snapshots st ON s.symbol = st.symbol
                WHERE 
                    st.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
            )
            SELECT 
                sector,
                COUNT(*) AS total_signals,
                SUM(CASE WHEN hit_target THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS target_hits,
                SUM(CASE WHEN hit_stop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stop_hits,
                AVG(return_pct) AS avg_return
            FROM 
                latest_signals
            GROUP BY 
                sector
            ORDER BY 
                avg_return DESC
            LIMIT 10;
